findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: speedy_public_booking_app · Private data: speedy_public_booking_app, speedy_public_confirm_booking, speedy_public_cancel_booking, speedy_public_make_standing_order, speedy_public_suggest_improvement · Public sink: speedy_public_booking_app, speedy_public_sign_in, speedy_public_draft_status, speedy_public_suggest_improvement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: speedy_public_booking_app · Private data: speedy_public_booking_app, speedy_public_confirm_booking, speedy_public_cancel_booking, speedy_public_make_standing_order, speedy_public_suggest_improvement · Public sink: speedy_public_booking_app, speedy_public_sign_in, speedy_public_draft_status, speedy_public_suggest_improvement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
